summary: Fitness Champs Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing and closing of a best-efforts public offering of 3,225,000 units at $1.55 per unit, each consisting of one Class A ordinary share (or pre-funded warrant) and one warrant. Gross proceeds were approximately $5 million. Univest Securities acted as placement agent, receiving a 5% cash fee and 1% expense allowance. Lock-up agreements were entered into for 90 days. The filing describes a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
